rg -r*.reason: `-r` is `--replace`, not `--recursive`: it rewrites every match and drops the line numbers. `rg` recurses by default, so drop the `-r`. If you do mean a replacement, spell it `--replace` — this rule does not match that

git commit -F.reason: This is `git commit -F -` with a heredoc body, which trips an approval prompt the operator must clear by hand. Write the message to a file with the `Write` tool, then `git commit -F <file>` — this rule does not match that spelling
